  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar o desenho de solução de integração e consolidação de dados das aplicações/análises.
  • Implementar soluções para pipeline de dados que automatizam a coleta, limpeza e transformação de dados utilizando as ferramentas Databricks de análises de dados (notebooks, apoio / Implementação ML, dasboards) e ingestão e integração de dados (Databricks Model Serving, Delta Lake/Feature Store, Data Quality, entre outras).
  • Desenvolver APi, rest entre outras, para coleta de dados.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com arquitetura Azure / Databricks - mandatório ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, engenharia de dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, NoSQL, Big Data e ferramentas de análise de dados (data Bricks, PowerBI, etc).
  • Sólida proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python, Java, Scala, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), como Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, etc.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de armazenamento de dados em nuvem (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, etc.).


Formato de trabalho


Remoto.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

title: Cientista de Dados SR
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Perfil da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar em projetos estratégicos de inovação, integrando inteligência artificial, ciência de dados e pesquisa aplicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções na indústria química.


Contratação: Cooperado

Duração: 12 meses (com possibilidade de renovação)


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos e redes neurais aplicados aos projetos.
  • Criar e manter documentação estatística e técnica.
  • Utilizar algoritmos de machine learning, deep learning e análise estatística.
  • Realizar coleta, limpeza, enriquecimento, estruturação e validação de dados.
  • Executar análises exploratórias baseadas em inferência estatística para identificação de padrões e insights relevantes.
  • Atuar com modelagem preditiva, segmentação e análise de anomalias.
  • Desenvolver estudos de caso com análise descritiva.
  • Aplicar conceitos de matemática, estatística e aprendizado de máquina no desenvolvimento das soluções.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com linguagens e ferramentas: R, Python, SPSS e SAS .
  • Conhecimento em machine learning, deep learning e redes neurais .
  • Experiência em ambientes on-premises e/ou cloud .
  • Sólida base em matemática e estatística aplicada .



Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!


Aviso de privacidade

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos. Caso haja alguma dúvida em relação à privacidade dos dados ou qualquer aspecto relacionado ao tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: Acesse o nosso aviso de privacidade para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos:

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Realizar análise de dados e modelagem de dados para suportar a tomada de decisão da empresa

- Trabalhar com Big Data para extrair insights e gerar relatórios

- Colaborar em equipe para desenvolver soluções e projetos relacionados a dados

- Comunicar de forma eficaz os resultados das análises realizadas

- Ser proativo na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e inovação

- Utilizar pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas para enfrentar desafios do dia a dia

- Habilidade de trabalho em equipe

- Excelente comunicação

- Proatividade

- Pensamento analítico

- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficaz



Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em áreas correlatadas à TI

- Pós-graduação em dados é um diferencial

- Experiência em SQL, Python

- Experiência em GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery)

- Experiência em pipelines de ingestão de dados como Airflow e Airbyte

- Experiência sólida em dbt (modelagem, macros, documentações e testes)

- Diferencial: Conhecimento em LLM (Vertex AI, Antropic, Azure OpenAI, etc..)

- Diferencial: Experiência em RAGs e DAGs para criação de pipelines de produtos de dados

- Diferencial: Experiência em banco de dados vetoriais e grafos (Neo4J, pgvector, ElasticSearch, etc..)


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

- Realizar análise de dados e modelagem de dados para suportar a tomada de decisão da empresa

- Trabalhar com Big Data para extrair insights e gerar relatórios

- Colaborar em equipe para desenvolver soluções e projetos relacionados a dados

- Comunicar de forma eficaz os resultados das análises realizadas

- Ser proativo na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e inovação

- Utilizar pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas para enfrentar desafios do dia a dia

- Habilidade de trabalho em equipe

- Excelente comunicação

- Proatividade

- Pensamento analítico

- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficaz



Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em áreas correlatadas à TI

- Pós-graduação em dados é um diferencial

- Experiência em SQL, Python

- Experiência em GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery)

- Experiência em pipelines de ingestão de dados como Airflow e Airbyte

- Experiência sólida em dbt (modelagem, macros, documentações e testes)

- Diferencial: Conhecimento em LLM (Vertex AI, Antropic, Azure OpenAI, etc..)

- Diferencial: Experiência em RAGs e DAGs para criação de pipelines de produtos de dados

- Diferencial: Experiência em banco de dados vetoriais e grafos (Neo4J, pgvector, ElasticSearch, etc..)


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Backend C# Sênior | AWS (Serverless)


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Backend (.NET / C#)
  • Experiência sólida com C# e .NET 6+ (ou .NET 5 / .NET Core 3.1)
  • Domínio de C# moderno : async/await, LINQ, records, pattern matching
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs REST com ASP.NET Core
  • Experiência com Controllers e Minimal APIs
  • Implementação de middlewares (autenticação, validação, logging, tratamento de erros)
  • Serialização e desserialização com System.Text.Json


☁️ AWS (Serverless)

  • Experiência prática com AWS API Gateway (REST e HTTP APIs)
  • Desenvolvimento e deploy de AWS Lambda (runtime C#)
  • Conhecimento de cold start , boas práticas de performance e otimização
  • Implementação de logging e monitoramento com CloudWatch
  • Uso de EventBridge para criação e roteamento de eventos
  • Mensageria com SQS e SNS (desacoplamento e integração com parceiros)
  • Gestão de IAM (roles, policies mínimas e segurança para Lambdas)
  • Observabilidade com CloudWatch Logs e noções de AWS X-Ray


Integração & Arquitetura

  • Experiência na construção de soluções assíncronas e event-driven
  • Integração com sistemas externos via HTTP
  • Uso de HttpClient com Polly (retry, timeout, circuit breaker)
  • Consumo e publicação de webhooks
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de arquitetura limpa / DDD light
  • (separação Domain, Application e Infrastructure)


⚙️ Infra & DevOps

  • Vivência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps ou AWS CodePipeline)
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) usando AWS SAM ou Terraform
  • Capacidade de automatizar deploys de APIs, Lambdas e permissões

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Product implementer / DTP freelancer
description:
Do you have a creative mindset backed by technical skills, experience in DTP, or a strong desire to learn?

BubblyDoo is looking for a hands-on freelance Product Implementer to join our team on a flexible basis, starting in Q1 2026. You will kick off with Valentine’s, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day books for our in-house products, but also for various licensing partners (such as Peppa Pig from Hasbro, PAW Patrol from Paramount, Barbie from Mattel, and more!). You’ll support the launch of new personalized children’s books and products, working closely with our in-house team and software developer.

What you’ll do

  • Use various in-house tools like our Translation Tool and Product Builder to fully implement our books and the translations of our books and products
  • Prepare and configure our CMS for each new launch
  • Have direct contact with our translators, illustrators and editors for quality review and product improvements
  • Support with organizing Photoshop files to ensure all visual assets are ready for production

What we’re looking for

  • Flexible availability starting in January 2026, with an initial onboarding and training phase, followed by a predominantly full-time availability through at least June. Workload may vary at times, and timing and continuation will be evaluated together afterwards.
  • Strong communication skills
  • Comfortable using internal tools and learning quickly
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and structured

What’s in it for you

  • Join a small, young, and passionate team that cares deeply about what we create
  • Take ownership and responsibility for the quality of our product line
  • Compensation to be agreed upon

For questions or more information about the role, don’t hesitate to reach out to

Looking forward to connect and to a great collaboration!

title: Desenvolvedor (a) PL
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job Title: Data Architect

Duration: 6months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

What You’ll Do

Design & Strategy: Develop and maintain the overall data architecture aligned with organizational strategy.

Blueprint Creation: Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support data storage, processing, and consumption needs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.

Governance & Security: Define and enforce data governance, data quality, and security standards across all data systems.

Technology Selection: Evaluate and select cloud platforms, storage solutions, and data processing tools appropriate for enterprise needs.

Implementation Leadership: Oversee the delivery of data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, and APIs.

Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability across all data systems.


Key Skills

  • Modern Data Modelling: Expertise with dbt modelling approaches and Snowflake‑optimized schemas (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).
  • Snowflake Architecture: Strong knowledge of virtual warehouses, scaling, clustering, and storage optimization.
  • Airflow Orchestration: Ability to design and manage complex Airflow DAGs.
  • Advanced SQL & Python: Expertise in transforming, processing, and orchestrating data.
  • AWS Infrastructure: Hands‑on experience with S3, IAM, and Private Link for secure and efficient data access.
  • ELT Strategy: Skilled in building ELT pipelines using tools like Fivetran and dbt.


Preferred Skills

  • Active Metadata & Governance (Atlan)
  • BI Semantic Layering
  • Data Mesh & Data Contracts
  • FinOps & Cost Governance
  • CI/CD for Data Pipelines

title: Consultor SAP SRM/MM
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma Pessoa Consultora SAP SRM/MM para atuar em projetos e sustentação, com foco em processos de compras, melhorias contínuas e atendimento de chamados. A atuação será em ambiente remoto, com desafios técnicos e funcionais em um contexto corporativo.


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no suporte e atendimento de chamados relacionados aos módulos SAP SRM e SAP MM .
  • Realizar configurações (customizing) de acordo com os processos de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias funcionais e técnicas .
  • Realizar dimensionamento de esforço para demandas e projetos.
  • Atuar com WEBDYNPRO , WORKFLOW de aprovação e ABAP para DEBUG quando necessário.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na otimização de processos e soluções SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SRM .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP MM .
  • Conhecimento de processos de compras: gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Experiência com configurações nos módulos.
  • Atuação com atendimento de chamados e implementação de melhorias .
  • Conhecimento funcional em WEBDYNPRO .
  • Conhecimento em WORKFLOW de aprovação .
  • Conhecimento em ABAP para DEBUG .
  • Graduação completa .


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em RM .


O que oferecemos:


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:
Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients , a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A .


About the Role


This is a hands-on FP&A role in a flat organization. While the right candidate may have a direct report in the future, this position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning analyses end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to influence business decisions through financial insights.


Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, and overall P&L performance

Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc analyses

  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment


Required Experience & Skills


  • 5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment
  • Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling
  • Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)
  • Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives (Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus, Tableau experience is a plus, but Private Equity experience is highly preferred)
  • Create and maintain dashboards, clean and validate data, and build data models across multiple data sources. Support cross-database integrations and deliver actionable financial and business insights.


What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.


Your applicaton will only be taken into consideration if your resume is in English!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA
description:
Quer crescer junto com uma empresa que está transformando a educação com tecnologia e IA?


Se você gosta de desenvolver aplicações modernas, tem curiosidade por Inteligência Artificial, e quer trabalhar em um time que está criando agentes de IA e soluções inteligentes no Azure, essa vaga pode ser para você!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA para fortalecer nossa nova área de AI Solutions e ajudar a construir soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, automações e integrações inteligentes.


Como será a sua contribuição no time:


  • Desenvolver agentes de IA, aplicações e APIs com foco em IA Generativa (agentes conversacionais, análise de sentimentos, tradução, sumarização, automações).
  • Implementar lógica e fluxos de agentes de IA, ajustando prompts e comportamentos conforme diferentes cenários de uso.
  • Integrar modelos de IA (LLMs) às aplicações utilizando APIs, SDKs e bibliotecas especializadas.
  • Construir e manter microsserviços escaláveis, com atenção à performance e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar o monitoramento e a evolução das soluções de IA em produção, garantindo estabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com áreas de produto, engenharia e IA, participando ativamente das decisões técnicas.


Se você… já tem experiência como desenvolvedor(a) full stack, curiosidade por IA e vontade de aprender e crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador — essa oportunidade pode ser sua!


Requisitos mínimos:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend (React ou Vue, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend (Node.js e/ou Python).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Experiência ou forte interesse em integração com serviços de IA/LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).
  • Criação e otimização de prompts para agentes de IA.
  • Conhecimento em Git para versionamento de código (Azure DevOps ou GitHub).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e serviços como:
  • Azure SQL e Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime)


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework ou similares.
  • Vivência com Azure Functions, arquitetura serverless ou integrações com APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Redis para cache ou filas.
  • Interesse ou experiência com Azure AI Foundry.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Vibe Coding), utilizando ferramentas como: GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, etc..
  • Ter atuado em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.


O que você vai encontrar aqui:


  • Um ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado contínuo.
  • Projetos reais com IA aplicada a problemas do dia a dia.
  • Stack moderna e liberdade para experimentar e evoluir.
  • Participação direta na construção de uma nova área estratégica da empresa.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento técnico e profissional.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!


Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.


Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.


Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!


Responsabilidades :


  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.


Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.


Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.


Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).
  • Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, report and dashboard development, and building interactive, business-ready visualizations based on enterprise data sources.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.
  • Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.
  • Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)
  • Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.
  • Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms
  • Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage
  • Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.
  • Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.
  • Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.
  • Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate


**ONLY CLT CONTRACTS *

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, possui presença global e reúne quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, oferecendo serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos, criando conexões reais e oportunidades consistentes.

Acreditamos que unir talento, tecnologia e as organizações certas gera resultados transformadores para clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — guiam todas as nossas ações.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Data Management Engineer para atuar no suporte, administração e evolução de soluções de Data Management em um ambiente global e multicultural.

Este(a) profissional terá um papel fundamental na estabilidade, performance e melhoria contínua das plataformas de dados, trabalhando com ferramentas líderes de mercado e colaborando com times distribuídos em diferentes fusos horários.

A posição envolve atuação técnica hands-on, automação de processos, monitoramento de ambientes e aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de dados para atender às necessidades de negócio e TI.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em conjunto com um time global, colaborando com profissionais de diferentes culturas e regiões.


  • Administrar e prestar suporte a soluções de Data Management, incluindo:
  • ER/Studio
  • EnterWorks (MDM)
  • Collibra Data Catalog
  • Collibra Data Quality
  • SAP MDG


  • Coordenar e executar upgrades técnicos, instalações e atualizações de sistemas e ambientes de usuários.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de sistemas, aplicações e usuários por meio de testes e análise técnica.
  • Monitorar ambientes e aplicações utilizando ferramentas como Datadog , propondo melhorias de performance quando necessário.
  • Interagir com fornecedores (vendors) para resolução ágil de incidentes e problemas técnicos.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico especializado e ministrar treinamentos sobre as ferramentas suportadas, quando necessário.
  • Manter e atualizar documentações de suporte e segurança, garantindo sua precisão e conformidade.
  • Trabalhar alinhado a práticas Agile , entregando demandas de forma iterativa e planejada.
  • Aplicar princípios e técnicas de Data Management para entregar soluções eficientes para áreas de negócio e TI.
  • Automatizar e otimizar processos operacionais por meio de:
  • Scripts em Python.
  • GitHub Actions para automação de rotinas e pipelines.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Management e Data Modeling.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em:
  • SQL
  • Windows Server
  • Administração de ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS)
  • Infraestrutura
  • GitHub
  • Datadog
  • APIs
  • Experiência com suporte, administração e resolução de problemas em ambientes corporativos complexos.
  • Inglês AVANÇADO/FLUENTE


Diferenciais (nice to have):

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com:
  • SAP
  • MDM
  • Modelagem de Dados e Processos
  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Snowflake
  • Power BI
  • ServiceNow



Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience
description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

title: Engineering Manager - AI Agents & Platform
description:
Engineering Manager - Agents

$ - $ + equity

Remote


This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role.

If you don’t actively use AI tools to build, test and ship software, this won’t be a fit.

If you do....keep reading.


We’re leading the search for an Engineering Manager for a fast-growing AI-native company building production-grade AI agents used by real customers, at real scale.


This role sits at the intersection of engineering, AI systems, and customer outcomes.

You’ll lead engineers, but you’ll also build, deploy, and own what ships.


What makes this different


You will:

  • Lead teams building and deploying AI agents in production
  • Own customer outcomes (automation rates, reliability, quality)
  • Make architectural calls across agents, workflows, integrations and evals
  • Turn real-world deployment learnings into platform improvements
  • Work directly with customers, product and leadership


You’ll still write code (perhaps with the help of Claude code/Cursor)

You’ll still review PRs.

You’ll still ship.


AI skills are a requirement


You don’t need to be an AI researcher, but you do need or want to be AI-native.


Ideally you would:


  • Be comfortable building with modern AI tooling (Claude Code, LLMs, agents)
  • Use AI as part of your daily development workflow
  • Understand how agents behave in production (evals, failure modes, reliability)


You’ll thrive there if you

  • Are deeply technical and outcome-driven
  • Enjoy ambiguity and ownership
  • Think like a founder, not a caretaker
  • Care more about impact than process


Why do people enjoy this role

  • Real ownership, real impact
  • AI at the core, not a side project
  • Small, elite team
  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Fully remote (UK/EU)


Interested...? Click apply or ping me a connection request...or both!
